text:
maria: Starting warmup for feature flag llm-route-sticky on prod canary. Rolling 1% -> 5% over next 30m. Keep an eye on latency and memory.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary rollout started: rollout_id=cr-1763-01, cohort=canary-1, target=5%.

aj: 👍 What's the sticky behavior? session vs user?

maria: session-based. We want consistent kv-cache affinity for low tail latency. Not user-id sticky yet.

liam: Noted. Adding a preflight check: if p50 latency increases >15% for 5m -> pause and pin back to previous model.

sana: Also let's watch token-per-request; batching change could spike memory. I'll add a dashboard.

maria: Flag config (short):
```
flag: llm-route-sticky
mode: warmup
slope: linear
start_pct: 1
end_pct: 5
duration_mins: 30
sticky: session
pin_on_pause: true
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: p50_latency
    threshold_pct: 15
    window_mins: 5
```

ops-oncall: Can we ensure model-version pin is set for canary cohort? If rollout pauses, we want explicit pin to rollback variant v2.3.1.

maria: Yes pinned: model=v2.3.1 for canary; if pause -> traffic shifts back to model=v2.2.9 automatically per policy.

aj: Quick sanity: release notes link -> https://redwood-internal/release/1763. Added to channel header.

liam: If we need to abort, execute: `/deploybot abort-cr-1763-01` and then run `ff:llm-route-sticky -> 0%` with `--force`.

sana: I'll monitor and post alerts. If I see memory >80% for >3m I'll call for rollback.

maria: Thanks. We'll wait 15m then promote to 20% slope if no signals. ping @ops-oncall for on-call handover at 20m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Status update: rollout=cr-1763-01 progress=2% at 10m. No alerts.

aj: All good from my side. Tagging for post-rollout notes.

maria: Love it. Keeping this thread for any rapid ops calls. :rocket:
